description: Find named hiking trails within a radius of a coordinate, ranked by how much is known about each rather than by raw length, so service roads and sidewalks do not lead the list. Returns distance, elevation gain, and route shape where known. Call this when someone asks what to hike near a place.

radius_miles.description: Search radius in miles. Defaults to 25, max 100.

name: find_trails
title: Trails near a coordinate
